tagline: An intelligent power management company dedicated to protecting the environment and improving the quality of life for people everywhere.
hero_kpi_rationale: Eaton is positioned on the HPC/cloud wave through its strategic acquisitions in hyperscale data centers (Fibrebond, Resilient, Boyd Thermal), which strengthen its end-to-end offering from chip to grid, a key driver of structural growth.

kpis.name: Strategic acquisitions in data centers
kpis.explanation: Number and scope of targeted acquisitions to strengthen end-to-end coverage from chip to grid in hyperscale data centers.
kpis.description: Eaton has deployed a targeted acquisition strategy to strengthen its data center solutions: Fibrebond (modular solutions for hyperscale and multi-tenant data centers), Resilient (solid-state transformer technology), Boyd Thermal (chip-to-grid liquid cooling), Ultra PCS (next-generation aerospace solutions).
kpis.signal: Four major acquisitions completed or announced in 2025-2026 (Fibrebond, Resilient, Ultra PCS, Boyd Thermal).

kpis.name: Momentum in data centers and aerospace
kpis.explanation: Eaton's positioning on the two primary growth drivers: hyperscale data centers and aerospace defense market.
kpis.description: The company is positioned to benefit from megatrends in electrification, digitalization, and reindustrialization, with particular momentum in data centers (post-acquisitions Boyd Thermal, Fibrebond, Resilient) and growth cycle in commercial aerospace-defense.
kpis.signal: Eaton benefits from momentum in data centers and a growth cycle in aerospace defense.

ai_positioning.summary: Eaton's AI positioning is implicit rather than explicit. The company emphasizes intelligent power management and data center solutions which are foundational to AI infrastructure, particularly through acquisitions enabling chip-to-grid solutions. The strategic focus on hyperscale data centers and AI-ready cooling solutions (Boyd Thermal acquisition) positions Eaton as an infrastructure enabler for AI workloads. Direct AI mentions are limited in the 10-K, but the acquisition strategy and capability buildout clearly target the infrastructure requirements of AI systems.
evidence: Boyd Thermal acquisition described as enabling 'chip to the grid' solutions for hyperscale and colocation customers
